grammar.explanation: 怕什么啊 may challenge or reassure someone’s fear, rather than ask the name of a feared object. In a friendly conversation it can still sound dismissive; 我陪你 is often kinder. Read context and intonation, and do not infer permission.

examples.py: pà shén me a , wǒ péi nǐ .
examples.en: What is there to fear? I will accompany you.

examples.py: jí shén me a , hái méi dào shí jiān .
examples.en: Why rush? The time has not come yet.

examples.py: xiào shén me a , xiān tīng wǒ shuō wán .
examples.en: What are you laughing at? Hear me out first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 怕什么啊一定是温柔安慰。
commonMistakes.right: 要看语气，也可能显得不耐烦。
commonMistakes.why: The pattern can be dismissive depending on delivery.

grammar.pattern: 并 + 没有 / 不：再辨范围
grammar.explanation: 我并没有取消 denies cancelling; it does not deny changing the room. Retrieve the earlier emphatic negation by specifying exactly what is denied. A strong denial remains an assertion, not external proof.

examples.zh: 我并没有取消，只换了房间。
examples.py: wǒ bìng méi yǒu qǔ xiāo , zhǐ huàn le fáng jiān .
examples.en: I did not cancel; I only changed the room.

examples.py: tā bìng bù tǎo yàn zhè bù jù .
examples.en: She does not dislike this series.

examples.py: wǒ bìng méi yǒu tì nǐ bào míng .
examples.en: I did not register for you.

commonMistakes.wrong: 并没有取消说明地点也没有变。
commonMistakes.right: 没有取消，地点仍可能变了。
commonMistakes.why: The denial has a specified scope.

dialogue.title: A joke at the theatre
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what was denied and why a joke needs care.

lines.zh: 连续剧明天播出，今天剧场里演话剧。
lines.py: lián xù jù míng tiān bō chū , jīn tiān jù chǎng lǐ yǎn huà jù .
lines.en: The series broadcasts tomorrow; today a play is performed in the theatre.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 导演喊怕什么啊，是在安慰吗？
lines.py: dǎo yǎn hǎn pà shén me a , shì zài ān wèi ma ?
lines.en: The director shouts 怕什么啊. Is it reassurance?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 要看语气。我陪你可能更清楚，不替对方决定害不害怕。
lines.py: yào kàn yǔ qì . wǒ péi nǐ kě néng gèng qīng chǔ , bù tì duì fāng jué dìng hài bù hài pà .
lines.en: It depends on delivery. I will accompany you may be clearer; do not decide the other person’s fear.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你并没有取消活动，地点也没变吗？
lines.py: nǐ bìng méi yǒu qǔ xiāo huó dòng , dì diǎn yě méi biàn ma ?
lines.en: You did not cancel. Did the place also stay the same?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我只否认取消，房间换了。记者也要问具体范围。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ fǒu rèn qǔ xiāo , fáng jiān huàn le . jì zhě yě yào wèn jù tǐ fàn wéi .
lines.en: I only deny cancellation; the room changed. The reporter should ask the exact scope too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 眼前的旧直播录像不是今天现场。收音机有海浪声，不代表这里是海边。
lines.py: yǎn qián de jiù zhí bō lù xiàng bù shì jīn tiān xiàn chǎng . shōu yīn jī yǒu hǎi làng shēng , bù dài biǎo zhè lǐ shì hǎi biān .
lines.en: The old broadcast recording is not today’s site. Radio sea sounds do not mean this is the seaside.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: What changed despite the activity not being cancelled?
choices: The date of the old recording

questions.q: Does 怕什么啊 always sound kind?

reading.title: Warm teasing needs an answer
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 她热爱影视，迎接朋友时先问到达时间；性别不决定节目喜好。
lines.py: tā rè ài yǐng shì , yíng jiē péng you shí xiān wèn dào dá shí jiān ; xìng bié bù jué dìng jié mù xǐ hào .
lines.en: She loves film and TV and checks arrival time when welcoming friends; gender does not determine preferences.

lines.zh: 古城故事为人所知，伟大是评价，重大要说明影响，不能把评价当证据。
lines.py: gǔ chéng gù shì wéi rén suǒ zhī , wěi dà shì píng jià , zhòng dà yào shuō míng yǐng xiǎng , bù néng bǎ píng jià dāng zhèng jù .
lines.en: The ancient-city story is known; great is an evaluation and significant needs scope; evaluations are not evidence.

lines.zh: 直线和准确时间要核对，眼前看见的不是全部背景。
lines.py: zhí xiàn hé zhǔn què shí jiān yào hé duì , yǎn qián kàn jiàn de bù shì quán bù bèi jǐng .
lines.en: Check straight lines and accurate times; what is before us is not all background.

lines.zh: 咖啡放在一边，她好奇地听，播放以后仍可以说没听懂。
lines.py: kā fēi fàng zài yī biān , tā hào qí de tīng , bō fàng yǐ hòu réng kě yǐ shuō méi tīng dǒng .
lines.en: She sets coffee aside and listens curiously; after playback she may still say she did not understand.

lines.zh: 话剧里的笑和咆哮属于演戏，连续剧里的情绪不替演员说明私人经历。
lines.py: huà jù lǐ de xiào hé páo xiāo shǔ yú yǎn xì , lián xù jù lǐ de qíng xù bù tì yǎn yuán shuō míng sī rén jīng lì .
lines.en: Laughter and roaring in a play are acting; series emotions do not describe actors’ private lives.

questions.q: What is set aside while she listens?
Do sea sounds from a radio establish that the listener is at the seaside?

choices: A recording and the present treated as one

lines.zh: 咖啡放在一边，她好奇地听，【播放】以后仍可以说没听懂。
lines.py: kā fēi fàng zài yī biān , tā hào qí de tīng , bō fàng yǐ hòu réng kě yǐ shuō méi tīng dǒng .
lines.en: She sets coffee aside and listens curiously; after playback she may still say she did not understand.

extraReadings.title: What are you laughing at?
extraReadings.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 笑什么啊，我还没讲到好笑的地方。
lines.py: xiào shén me a , wǒ hái méi jiǎng dào hǎo xiào de dì fāng .
lines.en: What are you laughing at? I have not reached the funny part.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我笑自己的咖啡放错杯子了，不是笑你。
lines.py: wǒ xiào zì jǐ de kā fēi fàng cuò bēi zi le , bù shì xiào nǐ .
lines.en: I laugh at having put my coffee in the wrong cup, not at you.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，那先把杯子放对，我再讲。
lines.py: hǎo , nà xiān bǎ bēi zi fàng duì , wǒ zài jiǎng .
lines.en: Good; fix the cup first, then I will continue.
lines.speaker: a

choices: Naming the actual target of laughter
